title: Aureline M5 guided-exercise-step component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the guided-exercise-step family binds inside the frozen M5 learning-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-learning-component-matrix.schema.json). A guided exercise step names its practice state and how it validates the learner's work so an exercise is replayable, keeps explain and do separate, and never mutates live state without the ordinary preview and approval model. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-learning is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
